Expansion thing

As the wind dies down and the evening chill sets in, it feels like the air cools with the dying warmth of the day. But on an armored train chugging along the eastern railroad of New Texas, a heated argument breaks out between the heads of the Department of Agriculture and the Department of Housing and Urban Development. They get into a shouting match until three security guards have to be called in to pull them apart. The head of Agriculture says they need more food and water for the people, and the head of Housing says without homes there will be no people. At this point, President Hozumi shows up with two advisors to see what all the fuss is about. After a short discussion, the President suggests a solution and that is to expand their place southward so it will solve the overpopulation and bad weather problem. Everyone agrees with his proposal. By next month the expansion was approved and multiple small military units, along with several cartographers, were sent to explore the unclaimed southern territories. From mountains to dry plateaus, the east areas were very rocky. As they move southeast, the landscape slowly takes a heavy mountainous shape. Going further south, the mountains stop almost abruptly, revealing a thick rainforest made out of only green and dark brown. But the land wasn't the only thing to change, the weather has gotten colder and colder to the point where it was 50°F.
In the direct south region, another group was doing the same thing. They reported the trip to be a lot easier, because the terrain was gentle, and the landscape flourished. There was a huge area a few thousand miles south of the mainland, which was a flat, healthy land that didn't have many trees nor hills. After a while, there was a forest, where some hills were formed but not much, there were also clearings that occasionally appeared. The group, after a period of one month into the exploration and documentation, agreed to go without moving from the camp for a week. The leader in command, Vanam, was reporting info to the mainland centers, when a loud whooping sound in the forest was heard. What was that? she exclaimed, I dont know, maybe some sort of deformed creature. A soldier answered. Vanam ignored the issue and continued to report their findings. A short minute later, the same noise was heard again, That must be one crazy animal. Vanam said, talking to the mainland center. Shortly after closing her call, the group again heard the noise, but this time there were multiple. Calmly, Vanam stood up and ordered her soldiers to be alert, because it may be an attack from unknown locals. She went back into her tent where she updated her report regarding the sounds and the chance of an attack. A few weeks later, the group had forgotten about the weird sounds and made great progress traversing the lands.
Next month, all groups met at a single point and requested a ship to transport them back to the mainland. While they were conversing about all their findings, a group of an unknown animal passed them. All groups had seen that animal, but didn't know what it is. None of them talked about the animal because they figured it was just a rare animal that they just didn't learn about yet. A smaller group of soldiers asked about the animal, and to their surprise no one knew about it. They walked over to the mysterious animals and examined them. A soldier shot the animal with a tranquilizer dart so they could touch it without it moving. After they brought the animal to a research tent, they found out that it was an undiscovered animal. The entire group was ecstatic, and needed to examine it further. A few weeks later, the group finally made it home and all were awarded a medal of honor. The mysterious animal was no longer mysterious and was named the Boria.

At 22 of november, Coybai and Umuwan tried to launch an attack against the army of Pakámáy, which was vulnerable, believing that eliminating his army would plump the Chimor morale, Pakámáy did retret with his army, but did not suffered several cazoalties and this attack on the district of  Munices was seen as inneficient by the lord of Icumuy and both general were punished,but not removed from their position.
Two days after, Icumuy was invaded, the Saubas tried to defend the city to the last man , but at the square Guaru-Satun got hit by the shine of the Chatay's granade shine and got himself blind by the granade, and soon got his chest pierced by a bayonet, the Saubas present had their morale getting plumped, Coybay tried to led but soon got captured and his army surrendered, the other leaders of confederation went nervous, Litun Ronpa and his men surrendered, seeing that fighting at that point was useless, while Ñan-Moyso fled to the north, surrounded and seeing he couldn't do anything else,  May-Wukê Surrendered.

"Mama Chilla ordered and we did it, those who refused to get enlighten by her light were burnt with Chatay's wrath, but with that,not just we fullfiled the Heavens's will, but as well as we unified our people that, for so long have been desunited, that this day mark the glory of Chimor."

The generals Tinocô, Tsau-Can, Pakámáy and Kaynati will receive the Second class of the Cuyuch Kori(Golden victory)
For all the soldiers and volunteers who participate, they will be awarded with the 5th class Merit service Award.
And for all those who did not submitted to our rule, they shall be in Mitma for 2 years, while unemployeds and criminals will be sent to the new conquered lands at west to repopulate and remove any unrest, their idols and waqas will be transported to the capital remain under chimor Custody, the new lands shall be split into three provinces, Talarat, Llalla and Yangor.
